title: See Monument Valley with a Navajo guide
description: Travel between Monument Valley’s sandstone buttes with a Navajo guide who knows the land as more than a famous image. From the vehicle, watch formations shift in relation to one another and hear stories, place names, and perspectives that a self-guided drive cannot provide. A guided visit also opens routes beyond the public loop where permitted.
teaser: Explore Monument Valley with a local Navajo guide.
goodToKnow: Dirt roads may be rough; request a comfortable vehicle and limited walking.
whyItMightDelightYou: The guide’s knowledge gives depth to a landscape you may think you already know from photographs.
